appDescription: A read-only vehicle record app that reports this car's battery, range, trips, charging cost and maintenance from the owner's DANIM records.

function.name: GET_VEHICLE_BRIEFING
function.description: Reports the car's current battery level, driving range and whether today's planned round trip fits without charging.

function.name: ANSWER_RECORD_QUESTION
function.description: Answers one question from the owner's vehicle records, such as weekly driving distance, charging cost, upcoming maintenance or the cheapest time to charge.

topic.description: The record the driver is asking about.

function.name: SHOW_NEARBY_CHARGERS
function.description: Shows nearby charging stations in the navigation app.
